hooks.name: Check URL Validation & Timeout on Save
hooks.description: Warn when a file that fetches GitHub URLs is missing the allowlist regex or 10-second timeout guard.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi

echo "=== Security check: URL validation & timeout in $FILE ==="

WARNINGS=""

# 1. URL allowlist pattern check
# Must contain the github.com regex anchored to owner/repo shape
if ! grep -qP 'github\\.com.*[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]\{1,100\}.*[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]\{1,100\}|github\\.com/\[a-zA-Z0-9' "$FILE"; then
  WARNINGS="$WARNINGS\n  ⚠ No GitHub URL allowlist regex found. All user-submitted URLs must be validated against:\n    ^https://github\\.com/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}\$"
fi

# 2. Timeout enforcement check
# Look for AbortController + setTimeout (JS/TS), or timeout= param (Python requests/httpx), or context with deadline (Go)
HAS_TIMEOUT=false
grep -qP 'AbortController|setTimeout.*abort|signal.*abort|\.timeout\s*=|timeout\s*[:=]\s*10|10[_,]?000|10000' "$FILE" && HAS_TIMEOUT=true

if [ "$HAS_TIMEOUT" = false ]; then
  WARNINGS="$WARNINGS\n  ⚠ No 10-second timeout found. Every outbound HTTP request must enforce a 10s timeout:\n    - JS/TS: AbortController + setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10_000)\n    - Python: requests.get(..., timeout=10) or httpx.get(..., timeout=10.0)"
fi

# 3. Check that raw user input is not forwarded directly into fetch/requests
# Flag if we see fetch(`...${...}`) or requests.get(url) without prior validation call nearby
if grep -qP "fetch\(\`[^\`]*\\\$\{|requests\.(get|post)\(url\b|axios\.(get|post)\(url\b" "$FILE"; then
  WARNINGS="$WARNINGS\n  ⚠ Possible raw URL interpolation into HTTP client detected.\n    Extract and validate 'owner' and 'repo' tokens first; never forward the raw user string."
fi

if [ -n "$WARNINGS" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "⚠️  Security warnings in $FILE:"
  printf "$WARNINGS\n"
  echo ""
  echo "See .kiro/steering/input-security.md for full rules."
  echo "(This is a warning, not a hard block — review and address before merging.)"
  # exit 0 so save is not blocked, but output is surfaced
  exit 0
fi

echo "✅ URL validation and timeout checks passed."
